lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba8Tl4Au4 (reduced formula Ba2TlAu) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 216), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Au centers with a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 neighbors (2 Au, 4 Ba, 6 Tl), while Ba environments include 11- and 12-neighbor arrangements and Tl centers have 11 neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among the Ba, Au, and Tl coordination polyhedra.
